Title: Underwater Exploration
Content: During and after World War II, sound wave technology called sonar was developed and used to map the ocean floor. Underwater landforms were discovered using this technology. Observations of underwater earthquake and volcanic activity on the ocean floor and along the edges of continents provided more evidence of the existence of plate tectonics.
`text(One)` example of a mid-ocean ridge is the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, which was `text(one)` of the most famous ocean discoveries.
